name: O'will Corporation
summary: O'will Corporation imports, exports and sells food and beverage materials in Japan and internationally. Its range includes food additives such as vitamins, amino acids, emulsifiers and flavorings, and sweeteners such as high-fructose corn syrup and granulated sugar. It also distributes smart ceiling fans, steam traps and systems for treating wastewater. Dating from 1986, it has its headquarters in Tokyo, Japan.
